goal: Broaden interview evidence across Ukrainian and international sources without duplicating semantic concepts or inflating the catalog with low-value trivia.

rules: Wording variants never create another canonical question.
Theory and scenario questions may remain separate only when interview intent differs materially.
A recurring source hit normally strengthens source evidence/prevalence; it does not automatically create a question.
Absence from the catalog is not enough: recurrence and interview value must justify addition.
Ukrainian and international interview banks have equal market/prevalence priority.
Official docs/specifications validate technical answers; interview banks validate recurrence and interview intent.
